title: Local Services Ads Move to Google Ads: What Changes
summary: Google is retiring the standalone Local Services Ads dashboard and folding it into Google Ads as a specialized Performance Max campaign. Migration starts August 2026 for home service categories.
concept: Archie-supplied graphic (built by him via ChatGPT, not this pipeline's generator): a Local Services Ads listing card visually transitioning into a Google Ads Performance Max campaign card, plus icons for the five home-service categories named in the article (plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, cleaning). Used here as the --source master so consistent platform derivatives can be produced from the same real image, not regenerated.
